topic: Govt hospital MRI stays *free* as Telang
hook: Govt hospital MRI stays *free* as Telangana brings in private partners
tldr: Telangana plans a public-private model to keep MRI machines running in government hospitals, with scans free on referral.

beats.what: A PPP (public-private partnership) model is planned. Referred patients still pay nothing.
beats.why: The state wants MRI services at government hospitals to run without interruption.
beats.care: If a government doctor refers you for an MRI, the scan stays free under the plan.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana plans to bring in private partners to run MRI services at government hospitals, so scans don't stop. Health Minister C. Damodara Raja Narasimha said scans will stay free for patients referred by doctors at government hospitals. The New Indian Express also reports free MRI services at state hospitals. Which hospitals, how many machines and when it starts were not in the reports.

cards.title: 🧠 What's PPP?
cards.body: In a public-private partnership, a private firm runs or supplies the service and the government pays it. The patient-facing price is set by the state.

cards.q: How good are govt hospital scans where you live?
